Callout.Name: Climber Stuck on a Ledge
Callout.Message: Climber unable to move, below the ridge.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, one arm injured, no way down alone.

Script.Line: He is below the ridge and he will not move.
He says his leg has gone. He is talking, which is something.
You need the rope team. There is no way up that face otherwise.

Lines.Approach: They are on a ledge and cannot get off it, and there is no road within a mile of them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
